dict.string: OS mode hides the Dock and menu bar while it is on, and restores them afterwards.
Meeting mode records what your Mac plays (the other people on a call) along with your mic, so the transcript has everyone.
OS mode lists your Bluetooth devices in its menu bar so you can connect or disconnect them.
OS mode shows Wi-Fi network names in its menu bar so you can switch networks.
